core_obligations: Sufficiency: if both the morphism and its diagonal are surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, then the fppf local existence of objects comes from surjectivity and flatness of finite presentation of the morphism, and the fppf local existence of isomorphisms comes from the same properties of the diagonal, which is exactly the gerbe condition (proof lines 6531-6552)

Necessity: for a gerbe both statements are known, the structure morphism being surjective flat and locally of finite presentation by definition and the diagonal having the same properties by the corresponding lemma on gerbes (proof lines 6553-6565)
proof_roadmap: 充分性：结构态射满、平坦、局部有限表现 ⇒ 对象局部存在；对角线满、平坦、局部有限表现 ⇒ 同构局部存在 ⇒ 两条 gerbe 条件成立。
必要性：gerbe 的定理性给出结构态射的性质，另一条引理（gerbe 的 Δ 满平坦局部有限表现）给出对角线的性质。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is a gerbe if and only if both the morphism and its diagonal are surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation (author proposition at source lines 6519-6529, label proposition-when-gerbe-over). The proof (source lines 6531-6566) derives the two clauses of the gerbe condition from the two sets of properties in the forward direction and invokes the gerbe results of this chapter, including the lemma on the diagonal of a gerbe, in the converse (proof lines 6531-6565). The translation between the gerbe condition and the two sets of properties is the substance. H3.
